newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Merrill Lynch fungible bond priced at 36 bp over.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch fungible bond priced at 36 bp over.

text.p: Merrill Lynch and Co Inc said on Thursday that its A$100 million of March 2002 kangaroo bonds, fungible with an original A$200 million offering made in April, were priced at 36 basis points over government bonds.
The bonds, which carry a 7.625 percent coupon, were priced to yield 6.425 percent. Settlement will be July 23.
The original offering, rated AA minus and Aa3, was priced at 40 basis points over the March 2002 government bond in April, which then yielded 7.69 percent.
